content:
inc-bot: INCIDENT PAGE — p99 latency breach detected on canary: encoder-v3 rollout (us-west). alert id=INC-3151598642. triggered at 23:24 UTC. paging oncall. :rotating_light:
oncall-alex: acked. I'm on it. grabbing metrics and runbook.
sre-maya: tagging in — will pull steady-state and canary slices. any customer-impact reports yet?
oncall-alex: quick snapshot: p95 ~ 180ms (normal 60-80ms), p99 ~ 2.4s (normal ~450ms). streaming stalls increased from 0.3% -> 6%. error budget alert fired.
eng-runtime: saw the traffic ramp config for encoder-v3 — traffic shifted to canary from 5% -> 35% at 23:12 UTC (auto-ramp). we pushed a quantized variant; kernel fallback observed on some machines. might be causing tail latencies.
dm-elena: any active customers hitting this region? CX had one report about slow responses from partner-alpha at 23:30 UTC.
pm-sam: partner-alpha saw multiple timeouts; CS reported a degraded user experience. flagged as potential P2.
sre-maya: running per-node p99 and CPU/GPU utilization now. attaching quick logs snippet: 
```
2026-09-07T23:22:11Z node-42 kernel_fallback=true kv_cache_miss=0.12 stall_ms=1200
2026-09-07T23:22:12Z node-87 kernel_fallback=true stall_ms=1800 model_variant=encoder-v3-q8
```
oncall-alex: thanks. checking canary distribution: 35% of traffic across 6 pods. latency positive correlation with pods on GPU type A100v2-32GB-optim. pods on A100v3 show lower tail.
eng-runtime: that matches a kernel selector bug we patched in the runtime last week. quantized kernels choose a slower fallback for certain sequence lengths >512. our canary dataset had longer sequences.
sre-maya: mitigation options: 1) throttle canary back to 5% (fast), 2) pin canary to non-affected hardware (coordinated), 3) force fallback to fp16 variant for canary (requires rollout change).
oncall-alex: initiating immediate traffic scale-down to 5% to limit impact. issuing command in routing service.
inc-bot: ACTION: traffic-shift executed: canary traffic reduced from 35% -> 5% at 23:36:02 UTC by oncall-alex.
eng-runtime: preparing a hotfix: change kernel-selector config to prefer v3 fast path for seq>512; will need a config rollout to runtime agents (low risk). estimating 15-25m.
dm-elena: coordinating customer comms: Sam, can you draft a brief status note? we should call out degraded response times and rollback action.
pm-sam: drafting now. will include ETA for full mitigation and offer a follow-up with root cause once triage complete.
support-jon: collecting individual affected request ids from partner-alpha and a small set of customers — will attach in thread.
oncall-alex: post-traffic-shift metrics: p95 down to ~95ms, p99 down to ~520ms. streaming stalls back to 0.6%. looks like stepdown worked.
sre-maya: verifying SLA exposure window: between 23:12 and 23:36 UTC we breached p99 SLO for canary customers. estimating ~1400 requests beyond threshold.
eng-runtime: starting canary rollback to encoder-v2 (previous stable) as second mitigation to avoid further risk. rolling out canary rollback command.
inc-bot: ACTION: canary rollback to encoder-v2 initiated at 23:40:18 UTC by eng-runtime. rollback is at 60% complete.
oncall-alex: monitoring logs for 502s and error spikes during rollback. so far no increase in errors.
sre-maya: confirm telemetry: GPU queues drained on affected nodes. tail latency trending toward baseline.
eng-runtime: root cause hypothesis: quantized encoder-v3 variant triggered an unintended slow kernel fallback on A100v2 for sequences >512 tokens due to a mismatch in kernel selection heuristics post-optimization.
dm-elena: next steps for postmortem: collect per-seq-length latency histograms, kernel selector trace, and per-hardware perf profiles. assign to eng-runtime and sre.
oncall-alex: handoff to SRE for follow-up post-incident. I'll remain available for escalation.
sre-maya: taking handoff. creating incident tracker: INC-3151598642-RTC. adding eng-runtime and dm-elena.
pm-sam: sent customer-facing note to partner-alpha and internal CS. tone: apology, summary, rollback & mitigation, ETA for postmortem.
support-jon: uploaded request ids and sample traces to the incident doc.
eng-runtime: will open a PR to revert quantization flags for encoder-v3 in the canonical canary pipeline and add a canary compatibility test for seq>1024.
dm-elena: thanks — rough timeline: mitigation done (traffic stepdown + rollback) by 23:45 UTC; postmortem draft ETA EOD next business day.
oncall-alex: closing live alert loop. if any new regressions observed, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
inc-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (mitigated) at 23:45 UTC. final state: canary rolled back, traffic restored to stable routing.
